logline: A burnt-out bank employee uses a mysterious time-slip to undo his marriage - then spends the rest of the series reckoning with what he destroyed and what he actually wanted.

bollymeter.basis: Consistently ranked first in its cable time slot with a national average of 6.8% viewership; IMDb audience rating of 7.7 reflects strong affection for Ji Sung and Han Ji-min's performances.

seasons.review_body: Familiar Wife used its time-travel premise not as spectacle but as a moral reckoning: what does it mean to erase a marriage because you found it hard? Ji Sung's Cha Joo-hyuk starts the series as a sympathetic but self-deceiving protagonist, and the drama is honest enough to hold him accountable for the alternate timeline he engineers. Han Ji-min countered with a performance that made Seo Woo-jin's alternate-reality version equally compelling. tvN's series averaged 6.8% nationally and peaked at 8.2%, consistently dominating its time slot. The show is most effective when it treats the fantasy conceit as emotional realism: the question is not whether magic can fix a marriage but whether the person inside the marriage was worth fighting for.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere efficiently establishes the domestic exhaustion driving Joo-hyuk's resentment - the commute, the bickering, the sense of a life defaulted into rather than chosen. The time-slip device is introduced with just enough mystery to make the premise feel earned.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The coin toss on the bus platform - a small random act that the drama will turn into the axis of two entirely different lives.

episode_reviews.title: Who Are You?
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The midpoint pivot where the alternate-reality honeymoon wears off and Joo-hyuk begins to understand the full moral weight of what he erased. The episode's 8.2 IMDb rating marks it as the fan-consensus turning point.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Joo-hyuk's confrontation with what the original Woo-jin was carrying that he never noticed.
